title: The neovim plugin hides why a viewer exits
body:
`M.start` in `editors/nvim/lua/acre/init.lua` starts `acre-gui --stdio` with `jobstart` and handles only `on_stdout` and `on_exit`. The viewer's stderr goes nowhere, so a viewer that exits at startup (a panic, a failed build in `scripts/launch`, no display) leaves `:AcreView` doing nothing visible. The plugin reports only a `jobstart` failure.

## Proposal

Collect the job's stderr, and when the job exits with a non-zero status, show its last lines with `vim.notify` at error level.
